title: AWF Token Usage Record
description: A single per-API-call token usage record emitted to token-usage.jsonl by the AWF api-proxy sidecar.

_schema.description: Schema identifier and version for this record (e.g. "token-usage/v0.26.0"). Dev builds use "token-usage/v0.0.0-dev".

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the API call completed.

event.description: Stable event discriminator for token usage records.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this API request (UUID or provider-assigned ID).

provider.description: LLM provider that handled this request.

model.description: Model name returned by the provider (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514').

path.description: API endpoint path for this request (e.g. '/v1/messages', '/v1/chat/completions').

requested_endpoint.description: Copilot wire endpoint requested by the client when AWF translated it to another endpoint.

upstream_endpoint.description: Copilot wire endpoint used upstream when AWF translated the request.

status.description: HTTP response status code returned by the provider.

streaming.description: Whether the response was a streaming (SSE) response.

cache_read_tokens.description: Number of tokens read from the provider's prompt cache (Anthropic cache_read_input_tokens or OpenAI cached_tokens).

cache_write_tokens.description: Number of tokens written to the provider's prompt cache (Anthropic cache_creation_input_tokens).

response_bytes.description: Total number of bytes in the response body (optional, omitted for WebSocket upgrades).

purpose.description: Who the request is attributed to. "routing_classification" is an AWF-internal router classifier call (caller_source "awf"); it always wins over any caller header. "agent" (x-awf-caller: main) and "subagent" (x-awf-caller: subagent/<name>) come from the optional, unauthenticated x-awf-caller request header (caller_source "caller_header"). Absent when the request carries no AWF purpose and no valid x-awf-caller header.

agent_name.description: Sub-agent definition name declared by x-awf-caller: subagent/<name>. Present only when purpose is "subagent". Caller-declared attribution metadata, not an authenticated identity.

caller_source.description: Source of purpose: "awf" for a trusted AWF in-process purpose, "caller_header" for a valid x-awf-caller header declared from inside the sandbox. Present exactly when purpose is present.

type.description: Kind of advisory steering notice injected into this request.

threshold.description: Percent threshold that triggered the injected notice.

steering.description: Present on the request that first delivered an advisory steering notice threshold in the run; written at most once per threshold per run. Never written for the "little_left" notice, which has no threshold. See steering_delivery for every delivery.

type.description: Kind of advisory steering notice delivered with this request.

trigger.description: Why the notice was sent: "threshold" when a percent threshold (80, 90, 95 or 99) was crossed; "little_left" when about five model requests' worth of AI credits (ai_credit), or about five minutes (timeout), remained once at least half the budget or deadline was used. The little_left notice fires at most once per run per kind, has a null threshold, and is never written to steering.

threshold.description: Percent threshold of the delivered notice; null exactly when trigger is "little_left".

conversation.description: Opaque per-run conversation identifier: the first 12 hex characters of an HMAC-SHA-256 of the conversation opening (the system prompt or instructions plus the opening user turn) under a random secret that the api-proxy generates at startup and keeps in memory only. Comparable only between records of the same run (one proxy process); it does not reveal prompt content. Null in two cases: (a) a Responses request that continues a stored response (previous_response_id or a non-null conversation), which has no history to key; all such requests share one entry and receive each notice once per run; (b) an eligible request whose opening cannot be keyed (for example, Responses input that starts with a reasoning item), which uses run-level state.

first.description: True when this was the run's first delivery of this notice (for a threshold notice, the record that also carries steering).

steering_delivery.description: Present on every request that delivered an advisory steering notice. Each conversation in the run receives each current notice once.

model_fallback.description: Present only when the ordered fallback chain (apiProxy.fallbackModels / AWF_FALLBACK_MODELS) switched away from the requested model. The top-level 'model' and 'provider' fields identify the model and provider that actually served the request.

requested_model.description: Model originally requested by the agent (after alias resolution).

requested_provider.description: Provider whose listener received the agent's request.

model.description: Fallback model the request was re-sent with.

provider.description: Provider that served the fallback attempt. Differs from requested_provider for provider-qualified (cross-provider) fallback entries.

from_model.description: Model of the attempt that failed immediately before this one.

from_provider.description: Provider of the attempt that failed immediately before this one.

failures.description: Every failed attempt in chain order, starting with the originally requested model.

attempt.description: 1-based index of the fallback attempt that served the request.

reason.description: Why the previous model was abandoned.

status.description: Upstream HTTP status of the failed attempt (absent for connection errors).

x_initiator.description: The X-Initiator header value sent on the request. Determines billing treatment: 'agent' requests are not billed as premium, 'user' requests are. Present only for Copilot-bound requests.

billing.description: Billing/quota information extracted from upstream response headers (X-Quota-Snapshot-*, X-RateLimit-*). Present only when the upstream returns billing headers.

quota_premium-chat.description: X-Quota-Snapshot-Premium-Chat parsed fields. Tracks premium request units (PRU).

ai_credits_accounting_policy.description: Accounting policy applied when resolving pricing for this model (e.g. 'concrete_model', 'unknown_model_fallback', 'dynamic_selector_runtime', 'dynamic_selector_fallback'). Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_dynamic_selector.description: Name of the dynamic model selector used to resolve pricing. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured and the model was routed through a dynamic selector.

ai_credits_fallback_pricing_used.description: Whether fallback pricing was used to compute AI credits for this call. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_pricing_api_version.description: API version of the pricing data source used to resolve this model's cost, when known. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured and the pricing source reports a version.

ai_credits_pricing_catalog_id.description: Identifier of the shared pricing catalog used for AI-credit accounting, when supplied.

ai_credits_pricing_catalog_version.description: Pinned version of the shared pricing catalog used for AI-credit accounting, when supplied.

ai_credits_pricing_discount_percent.description: Promotional discount percentage applied to this model's pricing, when known. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured and a promotion is active.

ai_credits_pricing_estimate.description: Provenance of an estimated price (median of same-family or same-backend donor models) used when the model had no exact or configured pricing. Present when the price was estimated.

basis.description: Whether the estimate was derived from same-family or same-backend donor models.

family.description: Model family used for the estimate, when basis is 'family'.

donorCount.description: Number of donor models contributing to the estimate.

componentDonors.description: Donor count per price component (e.g. input, cachedInput, output).

sources.description: Pricing sources of the donor prices.

tariffFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the tariff used for the estimate, when available.

ai_credits_pricing_observed_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) at which the pricing data used for this call was observed/fetched, when known. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_pricing_source.description: Source of the pricing data used to compute AI credits (e.g. 'curated', 'models.dev', 'configured_default', 'builtin_fallback'). Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_pricing_tier.description: Pricing tier applied when resolving cost for this model (e.g. 'default', 'conservative'). Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_this_response.description: AI credits consumed by this API call. Computed from token counts and per-model pricing. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

ai_credits_total.description: Cumulative AI credits consumed since the start of the run. Present only when apiProxy.maxAiCredits is configured.

reasoning_tokens.description: Number of reasoning/thinking tokens consumed (e.g. OpenAI o-series completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, Anthropic thinking blocks, or Gemini thoughtsTokenCount). Zero when the model does not emit reasoning tokens.
